_comment: The per-event folder slug, shared by _slug in
postroll/ai/generate_media.py and ArchiveCleanup.slugify in
PostRollApp/Sources/Services/ArchiveCleanup.swift (#108).
Python creates the preview folder named by this slug. Swift re-derives
the same name months later to DELETE that folder, and nothing but this
file forces the two implementations to agree. Drift in either direction
is bad: a slug Swift builds differently misses the folder and leaks it,
and a slug that happens to collide with another event's deletes files
that event is still using.
The rule: lowercase, replace every run of characters outside a-z0-9
with a single underscore, strip leading and trailing underscores. The
slug is then '<org>_<name>_<ISO date>'.
An event can have NO organisation (#689). The venue leads instead, and
when neither is there the name and the date stand alone rather than
carrying an empty leading segment. The fallback is keyed on the
organisation being BLANK, never on it slugging away to nothing: an org
in a non latin script already produces a leading underscore and those
folders exist on disk, so falling back for them would have Swift derive
a name for a folder Python created months ago, miss it, and leak it.
slug is then '<org>_<name>_<ISO date>'.
Every `slug` below was MEASURED by running Python's _slug, not written
by hand, so the file cannot record a shape the real function does not
produce.
Sing\u2014Play carries an em dash as an escape rather than the literal
character, so the repo's own style hook has nothing to catch.

vectors._what: punctuation the org and name share
vectors.name: Home'r Bust!

vectors._what: an accented letter, which is not a-z
vectors.name: Vocal Colors

vectors._what: runs of separators collapse to one underscore
vectors.name: Sing / Play

vectors._what: leading and trailing separators are stripped
vectors.name: Trailing

vectors._what: a name with no latin letters at all, so the org slugs away to nothing
vectors.name: Symphony No 5

vectors._what: an org made only of separators
vectors.name: Untitled

vectors._what: an em dash inside the name
vectors.name: Sing—Play

vectors._what: no organisation, so the venue leads
vectors.name: Hamlet

vectors._what: no organisation and no venue, so the name and date stand alone
vectors.name: Twelfth Night

vectors._what: no organisation, and a venue that slugs away to nothing
vectors.name: Uncle Vanya

vectors._what: no organisation, and a venue sharing the event's words
vectors.name: The Town Hall Sessions
